My name is Minyeong Yoon, and I am a fourth-year PhD Candidate at the
University of Texas at Dallas.

My research examines the effectiveness of crime prevention programs
using quantitative methods, including geospatial analysis and causal
inference.

Outside of research, I enjoy watching sports, especially baseball ⚾ and
hockey 🏒. I've recently started learning to play hockey at a local
community sports center.

## Research Interests

- 청소년 범죄 
- 지역사회 기반의 범죄 예방 및 재범 방지 프로그램 
- 프로그램 평가
